title: Expert-2 Rule Sets
description: Knowledge bases written for Jack Park’s Expert-2 shell, dated 1984.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: Forth Wiz (blocks 50-85)
versions.note: A help system that recommends Forth words from a description.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
==== Block 50 ====
 0 ( FORTH WIZ )  : WTASK ;
 1 255  $VARIABLE WISH
 2 255  $VARIABLE ANSWER 255 $VARIABLE HOLD
 3 255  $VARIABLE KEY
 4 VARIABLE MATCH    VARIABLE CATAGORY
 5 : CHECK1 KEY $" @" ANSWER $+ $" @" $+ INSTR 0 <>  ;
 6 : CHECK 0 MATCH !
 7   WISH $"   " $+ HOLD $! BEGIN HOLD $"  " INSTR DUP WHILE DUP
 8  HOLD SWAP 1- LEFT$ ANSWER $!  MATCH @ CHECK1 OR MATCH !
 9  HOLD LEN SWAP - HOLD SWAP RIGHT$ HOLD $! REPEAT DROP MATCH @ ;
10 : TELL_WHAT_YOU_WANT PAGE CR  ." WHAT DO YOU WANT THE COMMAND TO

attribution.text: Written for Expert-2, Jack Park’s rule-based shell in MMSFORTH (Dr. Dobb’s Journal, April 1984). The source names no author for these rule sets. Preserved here for small-scale archival use.
